title: J. Storrs Hall's utility fog

tellings.quote: In 1989, scientist Dr. J. Storrs Hall >> [music] pitched the concept of utility fog, an active polymorphic material made up of trillions of foglets

plain: In 1989 a scientist named J. Storrs Hall proposed "utility fog": a material made of trillions of tiny robots, which he called foglets, able to link up and change shape into almost anything. Michels narrates this himself, placing the pitch at a NASA conference, in an episode about a UFO book the Pentagon tried to censor. He brings it up as a way of imagining how shape-shifting craft might be built.
